correctness.rationale: For event E_j with B_j incident to all a left vertices and every other B a leaf, its strictly positive weight factors into the fixed star product and independent leaf choices, with attachment probabilities p_ik=w_ik/sum_r w_rk. This proves m_ij=1+sum_{k!=j}p_ik and the exact inversion p_ij=(sum_h(m_ih-1))/(b-1)-(m_ij-1). If whole DA,DB independent, E_j is measurable in DB and m_ij is j-independent, forcing normalized columns equal and W rank one. For W=u v^T, the matrix-tree cofactor determinant gives Z(z,t)=(prod z_i)(prod t_j)(sum z_i)^{b-1}(sum t_j)^{a-1}; after degree markers the pgf factors into two shifted multinomial distributions. Both directions cover all a,b>=2 and positive real weights. Independent exact-rational spanning-tree enumeration for W=[[1,1],[1,2]] checks m_11=4/3 and m_12=3/2; for uniform W, m_11=m_12=5/4. Other exact finite cases corroborated, not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Independence of naturally paired full degree vectors is a structural invariant of Gibbs trees. An iff classification over every strictly positive matrix and a constructive inverse from conditional degree means give exact identifiability, with clear failure when weights are not rank one; valuable for weighted tree dependence analysis beyond any single finite count.

final_claim: For any strictly positive weights on K_{a,b} with a,b>=2, the random tree whole left and right ordinary-degree vectors are independent iff the weight matrix has rank one; conditional means given a maximal-degree B-hub recover all column-normalized weights and rank-one laws are shifted independent multinomials.
